blocks.content: This chapter covers Manipur-specific development schemes and its tourism circuit, which draws on the geography, culture and wildlife content of the preceding chapters.

items: Central flagship schemes (Ayushman Bharat, PM Awas Yojana, Jal Jeevan Mission, PM-KISAN) have been extended to Manipur, alongside state-specific welfare and rehabilitation initiatives, the latter significantly expanded in scope since 2023 in response to the humanitarian needs arising from the ethnic conflict (Chapter 11).

Relief and rehabilitation schemes for internally displaced persons — including relief camp support, compensation for lost property, and resettlement planning — have been a major and ongoing focus of both state and central government intervention since 2023, administered under the coordination of the state administration and, during the 2025-26 period, the Governor's central administration.

North Eastern Council (NEC) and Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (DoNER) schemes provide additional central funding and infrastructure support specific to Manipur and the wider North-Eastern region.

cells: State capital; Kangla Fort (historic seat of Manipuri kings), Shree Shree Govindajee Temple, Manipur State Museum, Imphal War Cemetery (WWII, Chapter 3)
Floating phumdis, Sangai deer habitat, houseboat/boating tourism (Chapters 1, 9)
Site associated with the Indian National Army (INA)'s flag-hoisting in 1944 during WWII; INA Memorial Complex
Shirui Lily habitat and festival (Chapter 9); scenic hill-district town
Andro: traditional pottery-making village; Moreh: India-Myanmar border trade town (Chapter 6)

blocks.content: ★ EXAM POINT: Moirang is historically significant as the site where the Indian National Army (INA), under Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose, first hoisted the Indian tricolour on Indian soil in April 1944 during its WWII campaign — a notable freedom-struggle-history crossover fact for Manipur, complementing the Battle of Imphal coverage in Chapter 3.

items: Relief, rehabilitation and resettlement schemes for internally displaced persons have been a major state/central government focus since 2023.
Kangla Fort (Imphal) = historic seat of Manipuri kings; Moirang = INA flag-hoisting site (1944, WWII).
Loktak Lake, Ukhrul (Shirui Lily), and Moreh (border trade) round out the state's main tourism circuit.
